how_to_apply: Candidates can apply for the GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish Recruitment 2026 by following these steps:
Visit the official OJAS website: ojas.gujarat.gov.in.
Click on "Online Application" and select "Apply", then choose GSSSB.
Click on the post name for Advertisement No. 454/202627, Bagayat Madadnish, Class-3, and click "Apply".
Review the "More Details" section for the full notification before proceeding.
Click "Apply Now", then "Skip" to open the Application Format, and fill in Personal Details (fields marked with a red asterisk are mandatory).
Fill in Educational Details, then accept the terms under "Assurance" and click "Save" to generate your Application Number.
Upload your photograph (5 cm height x 3.6 cm width) and signature (2.5 cm height x 7.5 cm width) in JPG format, each under 15 KB, via the "Upload Photograph" option.

Click "Confirm Application" under the Online Application tab, enter your Application Number and Date of Birth, review all details carefully, and click "Confirm" (no changes are possible after confirmation).
Note your generated Confirmation Number, then use "Print Application" to download and print your submitted application for your records.
Pay the requisite examination fee online through the "Print Application Form / Pay Fees" option before 20 August 2026.
Only one application should be submitted per candidate. If a candidate submits more than one application, only the last confirmed application with the fee paid will be considered valid.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish Vacancy 2026: Category-wise Details
content_sections.text: The vacancy break-up for the 100 Bagayat Madadnish posts is as follows: Within the total 100 vacancies, posts are reserved for women as follows: 13 under UR, 3 under EWS, 8 under SEBC, 2 under SC, and 4 under ST (30 women-reserved posts in total). Additionally, of the total 100 vacancies, 4 posts are reserved for PwD (Divyang) candidates - 1 each for Low Vision (40–70%), Deaf/Hard of Hearing (40–70%), Locomotor Disability, and Multiple/Other Disabilities - and 10 posts (10%) are reserved for Ex-Servicemen candidates. Category abbreviations: UR = Unreserved (General), EWS = Economically Weaker Section, SEBC = Socially and Educationally Backward Class, SC = Scheduled Caste, ST = Scheduled Tribe. The number of vacancies is subject to increase or decrease, as noted in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish Recruitment 2026 must be Indian citizens (or possess the nationality prescribed under Rule 7 of the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967), and must meet the educational qualification and age limit detailed below. A Diploma in Horticulture obtained from a Polytechnic of any Agriculture/Horticulture University incorporated or established under the Central or State Agriculture/Horticulture Universities Act in India. Basic knowledge of computer applications as prescribed in the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. Candidates who do not currently hold this certificate may still apply, but must produce proof of having passed a basic computer knowledge test before receiving their appointment. Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi, or both. The final selection will take into account all provisions of the educational qualification specified in the recruitment rules dated 22 May 2020. Age, along with all other eligibility criteria, will be reckoned as on 17 August 2026.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be appointed on a fixed pay of ₹26,000 per month for the first five years, as per the applicable Finance Department resolutions. On satisfactory completion of five years of service, candidates will be eligible for regular appointment in the Level-4 pay scale of the 7th Pay Commission, subject to the outcome of pending Supreme Court SLP No. 14124/2012 and SLP No. 14125/2012.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish Application Fee
content_sections.text: The examination fee must be paid online only - through Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or Wallets - after submitting the application and obtaining a confirmation number, by 20 August 2026 (11:59 PM). A transaction fee applies in addition to the exam fee. The fee is refunded only to candidates who appear for the examination; it is not refundable for candidates who do not appear.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish Recruitment 2026 will be made through a single-stage competitive examination, followed by document verification: The exam is a Computer Based Response Test (CBRT) / OMR-based objective (MCQ) test, consisting of two parts - Part-A and Part-B - in a single question paper. Part-A (90 marks, 90 questions): Reasoning & Data Interpretation (30 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (30 marks), and Constitution of India, Current Affairs, and Gujarati & English Comprehension (30 marks). Part-B (120 marks, 120 questions): Subject-specific questions related to Horticulture and its practical applications, covering Fruit Science, Vegetable Science, Floriculture & Landscape Architecture, Post-Harvest Technology, Natural Resource Management, Plant Protection, Basic Science, Social Science, and current trends in these fields. A combined total of 3 hours (180 minutes) is given for both Part-A and Part-B. Negative marking applies: 1/4th of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for each wrong answer. After the exam, GSSSB will publish a provisional answer key, followed by a final answer key after considering candidate objections. Both Part-A and Part-B have independent minimum qualifying standards of 40% each; no category of candidate can have a qualifying standard below 40% in either part. Based on the combined merit score within qualifying standards, approximately twice the number of category-wise vacancies will be called for document verification, followed by preparation of the final selection list and waiting list. Additional merit benefits apply as per government rules: widowed women candidates receive 5% marks added to their score (subject to conditions), and candidates with valid national/international/inter-university/All India School representation in specified sports also receive a 5% marks addition.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents
content_sections.text: While filling the online application, candidates must keep ready all original certificates related to educational qualification, age, category (SC/ST/SEBC/EWS), disability (if applicable), and Ex-Servicemen status (if applicable), and must fill in accurate details as per these certificates. Reserved category candidates must produce category certificates in the Gujarat Government-prescribed format from a competent authority. SEBC candidates must produce a non-creamy layer certificate obtained between 1 April 2024 and 17 August 2026; EWS candidates must produce an Annexure-KH/Parishisht-Ga certificate or an Income and Asset Certificate obtained within the prescribed window. PwD candidates must produce a Disability Certificate (Form V/VI/VII) confirming at least 40% disability from a Civil Surgeon or competent medical authority.

faq.question: Q1. What is GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board (GSSSB) to fill 100 Bagayat Madadnish (Horticulture Assistant), Class-3 posts under the Directorate of Horticulture, Gujarat, through a competitive examination.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 100 vacancies are available: 41 Unreserved, 10 EWS, 27 SEBC, 7 SC, and 15 ST, with additional reservation for women, PwD, and Ex-Servicemen candidates within these numbers.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window is open from 3 August 2026 (2:00 PM) to 17 August 2026 (11:59 PM). The exam fee must be paid by 20 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish?
faq.answer: A Diploma in Horticulture from a Polytechnic of a recognized Agriculture/Horticulture University, along with basic computer knowledge and adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 33 years as on 17 August 2026, with age relaxation available for women, reserved category, and PwD candidates as detailed in the age limit table above.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹500 for Unreserved candidates and ₹400 for reserved category candidates (women of all categories, SEBC, SC, ST, EWS, PwD, and Ex-Servicemen). The fee is refunded to candidates who appear for the examination.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through ojas.gujarat.gov.in between 3 August 2026 and 17 August 2026, following the step-by-step process described above.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a single competitive CBRT/OMR examination with Part-A (90 marks: Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, Constitution/Current Affairs/Comprehension) and Part-B (120 marks: Horticulture subject-specific questions), followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates receive a fixed pay of ₹26,000 per month for the first five years, after which they become eligible for regular appointment in the Level-4 pay scale of the 7th Pay Commission, subject to satisfactory service.

faq.question: Q10. Is there negative marking in the GSSSB Bagayat Madadnish exam?
faq.answer: Yes. For each wrong answer, 1/4th of the marks allotted to that question is deducted from the candidate's score.
